docs.text: Today was the first day of our annual NSF funded project on the Lake Superior Basin. I presented my work on the lithological controls on erosion processes in bedrock rivers and the fluvial geomorphology on the North Shore. 🏞️🌊🏔️🧊

Had a great time at the #Michigan Gem and Mineral Society’s 2025 Rock, Mineral and Fossil Show in Jackson yesterday, talking to visitors about #GlacialErratics and research we’re doing at EMU on #GreatLakes glacial history If you’re in the area go check it out this weekend! #RockShow #Geology
I don’t know. It’s been 45 years since my geology classes. I live in far NE Illinois just a few miles from Lake Michigan.

#Geology conference in northern #Minnesota next week! Come to the Iron Range - anyone can enjoy the field trips and presentations. Appropriate for students, enthusiasts, and the geo-curious! 🧪⚒️ Institute on Lake Superior Geology www.lakesuperiorgeology.org/MtIron2025/i...

Conference on #Geology in the region of Lake Superior - upcoming in Mountain Iron, #Minnesota, May 15 and 16 with field trips on the 14th and 17th! 🧪⚒️

#geologists I'm doing a #bicycle trip of Lake Huron and the Bruce Peninsula in #Ontario latter in the summer. Looking for a #geology book like 'Roadside geology of New York', any suggestions, but for the area.
I find that when I #cycle I get interested in #topography for obvious reasons […]

Many years ago, teaching in NY, I had an undergrad in Sed/Strat do a research project on the provenance of reworked glacial cobbles from the beach on Lake Ontario. The majority came from the local Ordovician but frequency dropped off with increasing age and transport distance, all the way to Canada.

First day out hunting for #MichiganErratics for my #NSF award reexamining the timing of #LaurentideIceSheet retreat from the #GreatLakes region. Not all are usable for #10Be dating, but they exist! Will be back up to the Outer Port Huron #Moraine in July to keep the search going #Geology #Research

New Paper Alert! 🚨 2nd of 2 #UndergraduateResearch studies led by a past #EMU #Geology student! Schmidt Hammer dating didn't work for us in the #GreatLakes. We muse on why we think our 'negative results' are still useful! #EarthScience #Glacial #Geochronology
onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/...

Got my #GlacialGeology course out to the #EMU Fish Lake Environmental Field Station near Lapeer #Michigan last Friday. It's mapped as end #moraine, but jury's out. Lots of glaciofluval seds, #kettles, and a nearby #esker. More work to do! #Geology #EarthScience #GreatLakes
I am also interested in the late glacial in the Great Lakes, hopefully to reconstruct them!

Doing a deep dive into the geology of the Lake Superior North Shore of MN, for the RedLine artist book. The book depicts the ferrodiorite intrusion in the ophitic olivine diabase. I studied geology in college before transferring to music and art. That science background has been useful lifelong.

I received funding through a AGeS Diversity in Geochronology sub-award in 2024 (that's the new data mentioned above). This award allowed me and two undergrad to collect samples from the Sturgis Moraine and measure them to learn more about the glacial history of the Great Lakes
